messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
As of 14 November 2026, is the periodic verification of the P&H R200 mobile crane at position 17 overdue?

response.text: Al 14 novembre 2026, la verifica periodica della gru mobile P&H R200 in posizione 17 è scaduta?
